description: The fabula: what happened in the story world, in true order, including what nobody saw. Holmes's and Watson's own investigation is in actions.json. Each facet becomes a slot whose true value is given here; an array means the story narrows it to these values but never settles it; null means the story never says. 'implied' marks events the text infers rather than shows.
